notes.title: Sneak Peek
notes.content:
[h1]PSS PSS PSS![/h1]

Pixie looks delicate, but beneath the velvet skin hums a mind as sharp as any blade. Half mystery, half temptation, she blurs the line between machine precision and dangerous desire.

Now let's see what she can do on a battlefield:
[b]1 skill:[/b]On spawn or when any mercenary (except Freemen) Steals Attack: Stuns a random enemy (except Modules) for 1 turn
[b]2 skill:[/b] On enemy spawn: Steals Attack from Stunned enemies (except Modules)
[b]3 skill:[/b] Start of turn: Deals damage equal to her Attack to the enemy

Pixie has high field control potential, which accelerates drastically when paired with steal attack mechanics. If left untouched, she accumulates high attack and damages enemy commander directly, bypassing any number of mercs on the line!

If you are interested in this one kind of a merc — don't miss the event [b]"Vanished in the Shadows"[/b] that will be out on [b]September, 12 at 10:00 UTC[/b]!

notes.title: Big Alliances update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869949/9086787a7305c56da083194cf193f9b3b62bcf65.png[/img]
We've got big news: We've given the Alliance system a major overhaul! And we're ready to tell you exactly what's changed. Let's get started!

[h3][b]Meet the Androids![/b][/h3]
The Android is our latest addition to the game. The Android is your brand-new assistant which helps you out during your fights against other players on the Battlefield. Each Android has two abilities: one active and one passive. The active ability works one time per game at the beginning of the turn. Study all abilities and choose your Android wisely.

You can have up to three Androids in your squad at a time. Each Android has one of three tiers: R, SR, SSR. These determine the strength of the Android and how many resources it will take to upgrade it.

You can only obtain the Androids from Alliance activities. You will need to collect Encryption Keys, which can be purchased from the Heli Racing Market or the War Spoils. It usually contains Encryption Keys for two Androids: one SR tier, the other SSR tier. To give you a chance to get your favorite Android, there is a rotation in the market: SR Encryption Keys are rotated every month, and SSR Encryption Keys are rotated once per season.

Androids will increase your Commander's health. The value of the HP increase depends on the level of the Android. This buff applies from the moment you have an Android in your collection. Androids that are not in your squad but in your collection will buff your Commander's HP too.

You will need Android Points and Android Gold to upgrade your Android. These work in the same way as mercenary points and credits. You can find these resources on the Alliance War map or in the Alliance rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869949/00de3d62eb10c6dea96d1b6f3aa9970133da13bc.png[/img]

[h3][b]Alliance Wars will now be divided into seasons![/b][/h3]
We're introducing seasons for the Alliance Wars, each lasting 3 months.

During the season, each player will receive temporary units in their squad: [b]Super Twins[/b]. We have introduced new resources to upgrade them: turbo cores and red neo-cubes. These resources are earned by participating and winning in Alliance Wars.

Super Twins are much stronger than regular units, but at the end of each season, Super Twins will leave your squad. Remember that your Super Twins' levels will be reset every season.

At the end of each season, guilds receive generous rewards. The value of these rewards depends on how well the guild as a whole has performed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869949/63fdf4251138a5e89079c25e486921b58a0d3a52.png[/img]

[h3][b]A major rebalancing[/b][/h3]
We have rebalanced guilds to give newcomers and fresh guilds a chance to prove themselves.

We have changed the War Spoils roulette. The cost per spin has been reduced from 100 to 20. Now War Spoils has the same level for all players, and all rewards for all players have been increased accordingly.

War Bonds can now be earned in the Daily Alliance War Leaderboard, as well as in the new Weekly Alliance War Leaderboard, which does not take into account the number of tiles captured but only the Influence that the Alliance has accumulated during the Alliance War.

War Bonds are no longer rewarded for capturing and holding a sector on the War Map. They are now tied to the Alliance's position in the Daily and Weekly Leaderboards. So now, if you're a fresh aspiring Alliance in a war with other fresh Alliances, you can get the same amount of War Bonds as the top guilds in the world by being at the top of your current Daily and Weekly Leaderboards.

Instead of mercenary points and microchips, the War Spoils roulette update will give you resources to boost Super Twins and Encryption Keys for Androids. Additional guild units can now be purchased with Turbo Cores instead of War Bonds currency.

We have added a seasonal Alliance War Leaderboard. This will reward Alliance members with valuable rewards once per season. The rewards include: lots of resources for upgrading Androids and resources for upgrading non-seasonal units. For example, by upgrading Super Twins and using them to win, you can massively upgrade your permanent units at the end of the season.

This update will be delivered to all players in the following hours. We hope that these updates will make Alliance Wars more dynamic and fair! Have a great battle!

notes.title: The War Update
notes.content:
Your Alliance is under attack! Reclaim the territories! Introducing a new strategic game mode—Alliance War. Send troops to map sectors, coordinate with your Alliance to claim territories and landmarks, and earn rewards for controlling them!
[h2]🪖 Alliance War[/h2]
[list][*] An Alliance War lasts for six days and consists of three daily skirmishes, totaling 18 war skirmishes. Troops can be sent in each skirmish, but each troop can only be deployed once per day. Therefore, it is important to allocate your combined forces wisely.
[*] The Alliance War map shows details for all tiles you can reach—this allows you to track troop changes on all tiles you can attack at a glance.
[*] To stay competitive with other Alliances, you can grow your troops. Use Turbo Cores and Neocubes, new resources that you can gain from Alliance events, and assign your mercenaries to your troops and boost their performance!
[*] Rewards in Alliance War are awarded for holding sectors. At the end of each third skirmish, you and your Alliance will receive the rewards associated with each sector under your control. The amount each player receives is proportional to the amount of troops they have contributed throughout the 3 rounds. Each player receives a percentage of each tile's reward, depending on their position in the Alliance. The rewards granted at the end of skirmish 18 (the last one) are doubled.
[*] Alliance War grants you War Bonds, a new resource you can spend in War Spoils to get Neocubes, Turbo Cores, Super Diesel, Legendary Merc Points, Emerix Gems, and Micro Chips. The amount of rewards is scaled with the level of the War Spoils, which increases with the number of spins.
[*] There are several War Tiers your Alliance may be placed on: Tier 1 receives more resources like Emerixes and Legendary Mercenaries from tiles, while Tier 2 and Tier 3 get more War Bonds.
[/list]You can learn more about Alliance War by clicking on the (i) button in the upper left corner in the Alliance War window.
[h2]🍑 General Changes[/h2]
[list][*] - Added Polish language support! You can switch your game's language in the settings.
[*] You can now use replies to messages in chats.
[*] New battle backgrounds.
[*] Heli Race shop now available when Heli Race isn't on.
[*] Various bug fixes and stability improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Having a hot game? Well we're here to deliver an even hotter experience for you! 😎

Here's our first update, bundled with bug fixes, performance improvements on some devices, and an extra-special way for you to get some more booty! Let's dive in.

[h1]General Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Referrals[/b] — invite your friends to play Lust Goddess, give them a quick starting boost, and receive a ton of hot stuff when they reach certain Leagues 🥵
[*] When you send a referral code, your friend will need to install the game and enter it into the Promotion Code tab in their profile. Note: you can only use a referral code until you've reached League 26!
[*] Updated combat Stims to display their effect right on the field. Saved you a click!
[*] Fixed graphical bugs that could occur on some devices that rendered the game using Vulkan.
[*] Changed the Esc button to always bring up the "Exit the game" dialog window instead of going into windowed mode first. You can still control the fullscreen behavior in settings.
[*] Fixed some graphical bugs with Love Direct portraits, Commander cards in Squad, and in quests in the tutorial Roadmap.
[/list]
